dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's going on? This Ruin Grader's... reviving itself! That's one Paimon's never seen before!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Also, that's totally unfair! Aren't we just wasting our effort like this? ...Actually, is *this* why the previous adventurer gave up?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Traveler, let's retreat for now and report this to Katheryne. Maybe she'll know what to do.
